articulation.label: pen
articulation.alt: pen: /p/ → /ɛ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: bed
articulation.alt: bed: /b/ → /ɛ/ → /d/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: net
articulation.alt: net: /n/ → /ɛ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: hen
articulation.alt: hen: /h/ → /ɛ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
